text:
alex: Heads-up: Moorland VPC cutover scheduled Tue 09:00 PST. Quick sync on remaining blockers + ownership? I'm OOO Mon morning but can be on call at cutover.

maria: @alex noted. From infra: egress NAT + firewall rules ready? still waiting on Moorland network team for static IP allocation. pinged them this morning.

sam: I can own NAT + SGs. Need the customer IPs and VPN config. @maria can you post the ip ranges when you get them?

kevin: App team: we have a canary image built: `moord-app:2026-03-12-canary`. Need to push to their airgap registry. Who's doing image sync?

jordan: ops-bot: created task IR-472 for image sync. Assigned to me. ETA today EOD. I'll also validate checksums.

maria: Customer still has their airgap appliance in preflight. They said certs expire 2026-04-01 so we'll rotate during cutover. @kevin please bake cert reload into startup.

kevin: On it. I'll add a hot-reload handler and update PR #4022. @sam can you review? small change.

sam: Pinged for review. I'll look tonight.

jordan: Also found a flaky egress route for telemetry -> our monitoring host. Plan: route via bastion nat as fallback. @alex can approve?

alex: Approve. Make fallback default after 09:30 for 30m then revert if stable. Who will run smoke? @maria?

maria: I'll run L7 smoke and kv-cache sanity. Can we get load generator? devex-bot said there's a slot in perf lab at 08:30.

devex-bot: devex-bot: booked perf slot 08:30-09:15 PST. Resource lc-2 with 2 clients.

kevin: Two last things: need KMS access approved for customer key import and confirmation of HSM connection. @alex who signs off?

alex: I'll sign the KMS SR before EOD. Jordan, can you produce a short runbook snippet for key import and HSM validation?

jordan: Will do, posting runbook in #runbooks by 17:00. Also adding a rollback step to unpin routes.

alex: Thanks. TL;DR owners: NAT+SGs = sam, image sync = jordan, cert reload + app changes = kevin, smoke = maria, KMS signoff = alex. If anyone can't meet ETA say so now.

sam: All good from my side. Will update infra ticket with customer IPs once they arrive.

kevin: PR #4022 opened: https://git.company/pr/4022. Small note in description about cert reload. @sam review please.

maria: Customer confirmed static IPs via email. Pasted in IR-470: `203.0.113.12/32`, `203.0.113.13/32`.

alex: Closing loop: I'll be on call for cutover 09:00-10:30 PST. If anything slips we delay 30 min. :thumbsup:
